description: This file defines the DashboardService class, which provides methods for managing dashboards via HTTP API calls in an Angular application. It includes functions for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and sharing dashboards, as well as handling dashboard-related data and URLs.

classes.name: DashboardService
classes.description: Angular service for managing dashboards, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and sharing functionalities.

methods.name: getTenantDashboards
methods.description: Fetches dashboards for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getTenantDashboardsByTenantId
methods.description: Fetches dashboards for a specific tenant by tenant ID.

methods.name: getCustomerDashboards
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards assigned to a specific customer.

methods.name: getDashboard
methods.description: Retrieves a specific dashboard by its ID.

methods.name: exportDashboard
methods.description: Exports a dashboard, optionally including resources.

methods.name: getDashboardInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information about a dashboard.

methods.name: getDashboards
methods.description: Fetches multiple dashboards by their IDs.

methods.name: saveDashboard
methods.description: Creates or updates a dashboard.

methods.name: deleteDashboard
methods.description: Deletes a dashboard by ID.

methods.name: assignDashboardToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to a customer.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromCustomer
methods.description: Removes a dashboard from a customer.

methods.name: makeDashboardPublic
methods.description: Publishes a dashboard for public access.

methods.name: makeDashboardPrivate
methods.description: Revokes public access to a dashboard.

methods.name: updateDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Updates the list of customers associated with a dashboard.

methods.name: addDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Adds customers to a dashboard.

methods.name: removeDashboardCustomers
methods.description: Removes customers from a dashboard.

methods.name: getHomeDashboard
methods.description: Retrieves the home dashboard.

methods.name: getTenantHomeDashboardInfo
methods.description: Gets information about the tenant's home dashboard.

methods.name: setTenantHomeDashboardInfo
methods.description: Sets information for the tenant's home dashboard.

methods.name: getPublicDashboardLink
methods.description: Generates a public URL for a dashboard if available.

methods.name: getServerTimeDiff
methods.description: Calculates the time difference between server and client.

methods.name: getEdgeDashboards
methods.description: Retrieves dashboards associated with an edge device.

methods.name: assignDashboardToEdge
methods.description: Assigns a dashboard to an edge device.

methods.name: unassignDashboardFromEdge
methods.description: Removes a dashboard from an edge device.
